# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest version of PublishPress Cart. Please update to the latest release before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, pull requests, or discussions.

Report them privately through GitHub instead:

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/publishpress/publishpress-cart/security) of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the issue, the affected version, and the steps to reproduce it.

We will acknowledge your report, investigate it, and keep you updated in the private advisory until a fix is released. Once the fix is available, we publish the advisory and credit you unless you prefer to stay anonymous.
